verdict.rationale: Spline documents a Self-Hosted export that packages an entire project, with all assets and the Spline runtime, into a self-contained ZIP. It also documents code exports for Vanilla JS, Three.js, React, Next.js and react-three-fiber, which gives some way to take work out of the cloud. These exports are per-project web deliverables that depend on the Spline runtime, and the pricing page lists them as a plan feature, so they fall short of a full open-format exit. missing for 10: account-wide bulk export of all data, documented open 3D interchange formats (e.g., glTF/OBJ/USDZ), runtime-independent scene data, independent or hands-on corroboration of a complete migration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: The Self-Hosted export option in Spline allows you to export your entire project, including all assets and the Spline runtime, as a fully self-contained ZIP file.
Spline allows you to export the code of your scene as: Vanilla JS, Three.js, React, Next.js, react-three-fiber
